name: tags_by_applicability
note: AccountAccountTag._get_tax_tags and the tag_ids domains on accounts, taxes and products (addons/account/models/account_account_tag.py:76-90): every tag with its applicability, country, colour and active flag (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, applicability, country_id, color, active FROM account_account_tag ORDER BY id

name: tag_usage
note: account.move.line.tax_tag_ids / account.tax.repartition.line.tag_ids / product.template.account_tag_ids reverse reads: how many journal items, repartition lines and product templates each tag is linked to (the embedded relation arrays)
source_sql: SELECT t.id, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_account_tag_account_move_line_rel r WHERE r.account_account_tag_id = t.id) AS move_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_account_tag_account_tax_repartition_line_rel r WHERE r.account_account_tag_id = t.id) AS repartition_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_account_tag_product_template_rel r WHERE r.account_account_tag_id = t.id) AS product_templates FROM account_account_tag t ORDER BY t.id
